titulo: The four things your website needs to sell
hooks: Four things that make your website work
All your website needs to sell
The four keys to a good website
voz: A website that works gets four things right. First, it opens instantly on a phone. Second, it says straight up what you do and where you are. Third, it shows your work with real photos. And the big one: a visible button so people can text you directly, no runaround.

bloques.frase: says straight up what you do
shows your work with real photos

captions: You don't need anything fancy: a website works when it makes life easy for the customer looking for you.
Customers come in from their phone, want to see what you do and where you are, and talk to you right away.
Having a website isn't about adding more to your plate: it's about making your work clear so people reach out directly.
Clear info, real photos of your work and a button straight to your messages. That's how you stand out.
